description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, adding {C}{C}.
When Slimefoot and Squee dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Slimefoot and Squee from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
